# Distinguish omitted tag properties from an empty ordinal

For messages.tags.update, color and display-name updates use truthy checks, while ordinal uses != null. This permits an empty string to clear an ordinal without treating omission as an update. Preserve this field-specific distinction; replacing it with one common truthiness rule would change the API. The schema keeps these properties optional. This is a scoped syntax recommendation grounded in current source and historical tag tests, without runtime validation. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.

Scope: mail / components.
